title: A Survey on Moral Foundation Theory and Pre-Trained Language Models: Current Advances and Challenges
reasoning: The paper is a survey specifically dedicated to the intersection of Moral Foundation Theory (MFT) and Pre-trained Language Models. It formalizes and reviews tasks for evaluating and benchmarking moral values, identifies datasets and lexicons for moral foundations (such as Care/Harm and Fairness/Cheating), and analyzes how AI models align with human moral and ethical frameworks.
